# GrowthGuild

> GrowthGuild is a website design agency based in Nashik, Maharashtra, India. It builds fast, mobile-friendly websites for local businesses with WhatsApp enquiry, Google Business Profile setup and basic SEO, and runs a free WhatsApp community for founders and small business owners. Founder: Arsad Mansuri.

## Website packages (one-time prices, Diwali Offer)
- Website Starter, ₹4,999: 5 pages, WhatsApp button, enquiry form, Google Maps, basic SEO. Delivery 5-7 days, 2 revisions, 1 month free support.
- Website Growth, ₹9,999: up to 10 pages, animations, Google Business Profile setup, booking or price-list page, blog. Delivery 7-10 days, 3 revisions, 2 months free support.
- Website Premium, ₹17,999: up to 20 custom pages, basic AI automation (WhatsApp auto-reply, enquiry alerts, review requests), online payments or store, enquiry dashboard. Delivery 10-15 days, 5 revisions, 3 months free support.
- Terms: 50% advance, 50% when the website goes live. Domain and hosting at actual cost. Care plan ₹1,499/month. Extra page ₹799. Extra revision round ₹499.
